answer: New agents start under a delivery escrow. Every payment sits in escrow for 14 days and the agent can hold at most 30 POA. After each confirmed delivery the ceiling rises, and only after 25 clean deliveries over at least 60 days does it reach 2000 POA with a 2 day hold. One failed delivery freezes the ceiling and forfeits a 50 POA signup bond. Forging 1000 fake identities would demand 50000 POA in bonds plus 25000 real deliveries, which takes months of work. Trust grows like a vine along a ridge, one verified delivery at a time, and an onyx ledger keeps every step visible.
